coverage_notes: Section 15 contains operative dispute-resolution procedures and restrictions that cannot be faithfully represented with the supplied activities and objects: mandatory arbitration; informal-resolution steps and a 60-day period; settlement conferences; tolling of limitations; arbitration initiation, forum, procedure, and fee allocation; exceptions for small-claims and equitable-relief claims; individual-proceeding and class-action restrictions; batch arbitration; and severability rules.

Section 15.2 requires Customer to complete the Informal Dispute Resolution Form and OpenAI to notify Customer at the Account email address. Both Parties must attend an individual settlement conference if either requests one during the informal-resolution period. The referenced form is not supplied.

Section 15.3 incorporates the arbitration provider’s rules for administrative and arbitrator costs; those rules are not supplied. Section 15.7 provides batching when 25 or more claimants represented by the same or similar counsel file demands raising substantially similar disputes within 90 days; the agreement defines a Batch as up to 50 claimants. The stated fewer-than-50 exception and the remaining batching terms are preserved in the source but cannot be represented as license activity rules. No missing external text has been inferred.

paragraph_audit.reason: Lines 86–93 contain operative arbitration and informal-resolution duties, procedural and cost-allocation rules, exceptions, class and individual-proceeding restrictions, batch-arbitration terms, and severability provisions. None maps faithfully to the supplied activity and object enums. No clauses are emitted rather than mischaracterizing dispute-resolution conduct as a licensee activity.
